source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public 13–15, 16:1–35 and 18 align directly. Public 16:36–50 maps to Hebrew 17:1–15; public 17:1–13 maps to Hebrew 17:16–28. All 214 original records, including every annotation, are hashed exactly. Later numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Uses inclusive generic singular and preserves continuing residence and equal ritual obligation, not a modern citizenship category.
Preserves one rule and explicit equal standing in this ritual context without expanding it into an unqualified modern political claim.
Retains cake and first dough, with alternative coarse-meal sense noted, and the threshing-floor analogy.
Preserves collective inadvertence and broad all-commands wording; does not narrow to idolatry without textual warrant.
Retains explicit inclusion in forgiveness and collective inadvertence.
Preserves raised-hand defiance and cut-off sanction with explanatory notes instead of silently specifying an execution procedure.
Keeps emphatic cutting off and remaining guilt without softening to an administrative exclusion.
Does not pretend the uncertainty was necessarily only the method of execution.
Preserves divine attribution, death, community agency and location without explaining away the harm.
Keeps enacted death and agency explicit; no euphemistic punishment summary.
Keeps tur link to scouts and sexual metaphor for unfaithfulness; avoids sanitizing the heart/eyes contrast.
